entities.summary: Clifford Donald Simak was an American science fiction writer and journalist. He won three Hugo Awards and one Nebula Award. The Science Fiction Writers of America made him its third SFWA Grand Master, and the Horror Writers Association made him one of three inaugural winners of the Bram Stoker Award for Lifetime Achievement. He is associated with the pastoral science fiction subgenre. Clifford D. Simak was a journalists & chroniclers from Millville (1904-08-03, Millville–1988-04-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
